# A test reaches into a component the one under test renders, on every target:
# its state (`c.b.hits`), its nodes (`c.b.btn.click()`, one copy of a loop's
# `c.b.row[0]`), its methods (`c.b.reset()`), and a node's one-way prop, which
# is the expression its call site gave (`c.t.value`, `c.b.shown.value`, and an
# instance's own `c.b.label`).
#
# The interpreter reads each off the instance it mounted. Every compiled
# target splices `bar` into `main`, so the inliner points each read at what
# the splice made of it (internal/lower/test_reach.go), and a prop read is
# answered before the override replaces the node (rewriteTestPropRead).

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component bar(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    func reset() {
        hits = 0
    }
    vbox {
        button #btn(text=label, @click {
            hits = hits + 1
        })
        text #shown(value="{label}: {hits}")
        for var i = [1] {
            button #row(text="r{i}", @click {
                hits = hits + 10
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var greeting = "hello"
    vbox {
        bar #b(label="go")
        text #t(value=greeting)
    }
}

func testANestedComponentsStateAndNodes(t Test, c main) {
    c.b.btn.click()
    t.assert(c.b.hits == 1)
    t.assert(c.b.shown.value == "go: 1")
    c.b.reset()
    t.assert(c.b.hits == 0)
}

func testANodesOneWayProp(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.t.value == "hello")
    c.greeting = "bye"
    t.assert(c.t.value == "bye")
    t.assert(c.b.label == "go")
}

func testOneCopyOfALoopInANestedComponent(t Test, c main) {
    c.b.row[0].click()
    t.assert(c.b.hits == 10)
}

window {
    main
}
